seat.office_title: Monroe County Community School Board - District 5

topics.question_text: When a student wants to use a different name or gender identity at school, who decides whether parents are told?

stances.text: Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents unless the student consents.
Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents.
Require schools to tell parents when parents ask.
Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns.
